findings.summary: TERMINAL GATE OF THE REPAIR CHAIN: round 2 re-submitted the byte-identical commit af164b9/tree 44cda5fd already rejected under runs 32864270667 and 32875577618 — all three cycles' team branches are literally the same commit object with unfilled commit-message template fields ('Runtime cycle␣␣repair␣␣attempt 1'). The escalation rule pre-committed in the round-1 gate fired verbatim; independent audit verdict: gate=BLOCKED, safe_to_integrate=false, delta_since_prior_audit_bytes=0, with C10 status FAILED_ZERO_DELTA ('none of RF1–RF6 shows even an attempted edit'). Auditor reconfirmed live: R0 benchmark still never executed in any of three attempts (no traces/results/journals/overlay; RUNTIME_LEDGER.md and NEXT_RUNTIME.md still 0 bytes) — explicitly 'absence of execution must never be narrated as a null/negative result'; suite 10 failed/17 passed identical to prior audits incl. a test calling a nonexistent report() keyword — direct evidence the team never ran its own suite to green; resolver.py:180 TypeError ('Segment' object is not subscriptable) reproduced on E1/E2/E4/E7/E8 incl. both gold-keyed decoys on E8 (coverage raw 1.333/1.000 vs τ=0.30, decoys ranked above every genuine capsule; coverage normalization can exceed 1.0 — raw 1.5 recomputed on a 9-token query). New RF-X makes the blocker EXTERNAL/ORCHESTRATION: determine why the repair runner re-pushed byte-identical af164b9 under three run IDs and make the lane either execute repairs or halt honestly; dispatching further repair rounds before that would manufacture more zero-delta cycles.

ROOT CAUSE of resubmission #3 (LOG-ONLY, this bundle is the sole witness): attempt 1/6 was NOT idle — it spent ~22m42s productively loading context (audit gate RF1–RF6, runtime implementation, tests tree, pip/playwright probes, network probes) before OpenCode/Ox degraded: first 'network signature detected; watching for a 300s stall' warning at 17:40:48Z (4 such warnings total), then the watchdog killed only the stalled call at 17:47:34Z ('produced a network error and then no output for 300s') and backed off 300s — the bounded retry loop WORKED for this failure class. Attempt 2/6 (fresh context, 17:52:35Z) died ~4s in on 'permission requested: external_directory (/home/runner/work/Spider/docs/roles/*); auto-rejecting' while trying to Read /home/runner/work/Spider/docs/roles/RUNTIME_RUNNER.md — a path ONE COMPONENT SHORT of the real workspace root (/home/runner/work/Spider/Spider), i.e. recurrence of run 32851946087's parent-of-repo variant, now instance #6 of the cross-lane permission-kill family and the SECOND distinct wrong-path sub-variant in the Runtime lane alone (round 1 used a hallucinated 'Sparkle' project name). The agent then made one further ls probe of the mounted trees, produced no edits, and the persist step force-pushed unchanged af164b9 under conclusion=success ~5s later. Whether the second auto-rejection again terminated the session outright or the agent merely abandoned its turn cannot be distinguished from this log; either way delivery was empty.

Repair-environment gaps (operational): the runner venv had NO pytest (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pytest'), NO playwright module and NO playwright browser cache ('NO PW CACHE'), while the repair instruction demanded 'rerun affected tests/benchmarks' (RF3/RF4 require a green hermetic suite and an executed R0). Network was healthy (quotes.toscrape.com and books.toscrape.com both HTTP 200 at 17:40:48Z), so dependency installation was possible but had to be discovered/performed mid-session; the auditor separately ran pytest 9.1.1 under Python 3.12.3 in its own job. Every future Runtime repair/builder session pays this discovery cost unless deps are pre-installed by the workflow.

What the round-2 audit reconfirmed as SURVIVING from the rejected scaffolding (all durable on the audit branch): D4 derivation determinism VALIDATED_FOR_CURRENT_TEST — compile_registry() into a fresh directory reproduced 12/12 capsule JSONs byte-identical, dump sha256 prefix ec5af9e146ea629f matches the prereg pin; upstream Graph gate PASS/safe_to_integrate=true binds VERBATIM; credential literals absent; all capsules CANDIDATE tier; external contract surface ID-free (cosmetic effect-vocabulary tokens like SESSION_STATE(authed@quotes) noted; 4 submit steps render as "activate the control labelled ' '"). New precise pins recorded by the auditor: verify_ms is booked as hardcoded +0.05 constant at loop.py:83 (fabricated rather than measured); reuse_yield defined but computed nowhere; baseline fallback arms get max(0,30−reused) vs ColdExplorer default MAX_ACTIONS=30 on top of replay spend (baselines.py:99-105, explorer.py:25) — identical-budget framing violated unless disclosed; prereg/instruments/registry/evidence all sit in single commit af164b9 so git cannot corroborate freeze ordering (moot while no outcomes exist); running pytest regenerates runtime/store/registry/_derivation_report.json IN PLACE (non-hermetic suite, observed live via git diff) and that report embeds host-absolute paths unreproducible byte-for-byte from the committed layout.

~44m32s wall (17:24:30→18:09:02Z) to deliver zero bytes: TEAM 28m12s (agent attempt 1 ≈22m42s of context-loading nullified by the stall kill + 5m backoff dead time + attempt 2 ≈10s), AUDITOR 16m01s of thorough independent recomputation, BLOCKED notice 4s, Director skipped. Combined with round 1 (~21.5 min), the two repair rounds consumed ≈66 min of runner time producing no delta — both were converted into explicit knowledge only because the auditor asserted tip≠base; a cheap zero-diff persist assertion would have failed fast twice.

ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR_DELIVERY (third consecutive occurrence in the Runtime chain): persist step force-pushes HEAD even when `git commit` says 'nothing to commit' — no tip≠base/diff assertion between agent phase and push, publishing a byte-identical 'team output' branch under conclusion=success.

UNFILLED_COMMIT_TEMPLATE_FIELDS (recurrence): pushed subject 'Runtime cycle  repair  attempt 1: team output' with empty template slots across all three run IDs — confounds provenance automation keyed on commit messages.

research_opportunities: Codify the demonstrated recovery path for BLOCKED repair chains: per later evidence, the lane's productive continuation came from FRESH-WORK cycles (run 32887030457 delivered the first real artifact set; its R0-1 lineage was later accepted via run 32908007576's intake), not from further repair rounds — make 'BLOCKED ⇒ restart as fresh cycle carrying RF-list as input, frozen targets intact' the default orchestration rule instead of manufacturing additional zero-delta repairs. Track whether RF1–RF6 items were superseded vs still-open against the fresh lineage before treating the old fix-list as current debt.

Structural fix bundle (joins CF-10/CF-34 proposals, now with three documented loss mechanisms): (a) fail persist unless tip≠base AND non-empty diff vs mounted base; (b) degrade external_directory denials to single-tool-call skips; (c) canonicalize agent-constructed absolute paths against the real workspace root; (d) pre-install project test dependencies (pytest/playwright + browser cache) in repair/builder jobs or make the workflow install them before the agent runs; (e) checkpoint or summarize long agent sessions so a watchdog-killed attempt does not forfeit ~23m of context loading.

Cheap audit-side fast path already demonstrated: record audited-base tree hash at audit start and short-circuit when unchanged (the round-2 auditor effectively did this via commit/tree-hash comparison) — formalizing it converts future zero-delta audits from ~16 min to seconds.
